bio.text: Christopher Gallant is the Democratic candidate for New York's 1st Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Nicholas LaLota.

In a Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey response completed in 2026, Gallant said he was born in Smithtown, New York, has served in the U.S. Army National Guard since 2006, and earned a bachelor's degree from Dowling College in 2014.
In the same survey he listed his career experience as a federal employee and union leader, and said he also served as an Equal Opportunity representative in the U.S. Army.
